_source: IOGP Report 459 (2018 revision, 9 rules) -- rule names and action statements are Kind-1 sourced facts per the blueprint. Trigger concepts, example narratives and required_energy_categories below are OUR proposed matching architecture (Kind 3), not official IOGP text.

rules.action: Obtain authorisation before overriding or disabling safety controls
example_narratives: Operator bypassed the high-pressure trip alarm to keep the unit running during startup.
Interlock was defeated to allow the pump to run with the guard open.

rules.action: Obtain authorisation before entering a confined space
example_narratives: Contractor entered a tank for inspection before the gas test was completed and the permit was signed.
Worker entered the confined space without a standby attendant posted at the entry point.
Driver was using a mobile phone while driving between well sites on the access road.
Vehicle skidded on a wet access road after exceeding the site speed limit.

rules.action: Verify isolation and zero energy before work begins
example_narratives: Technician opened a flange before confirming isolation and residual pressure was released.
Line opened before confirming isolation, residual pressure released, no injury.
Electrician started work on a panel before confirming it was de-energized.

rules.action: Control flammables and ignition sources before hot work
example_narratives: Welding was carried out near an open drum of solvent without a fire watch or a gas test.
Grinding work generated sparks near an area with flammable vapours present.

rules.action: Position yourself to avoid moving objects, pressure release, dropped objects
example_narratives: Worker walked beneath a suspended load during a lifting operation to retrieve a dropped tool.
Employee stood in the pinch point between the pipe and the crane hook during positioning.

rules.action: Plan the lift and control the area
example_narratives: Crane lift proceeded without a documented lift plan and the exclusion zone was not established.
Rigging sling showed visible wear but was used anyway during the lift.

rules.action: Work with a valid permit when required
trigger_concepts: began without a valid work permit
example_narratives: Maintenance work began without a valid work permit being issued for the task.
Permit had expired but the crew continued working on the equipment.

rules.action: Protect yourself against a fall when working at height
example_narratives: Worker leaned out from a scaffold platform to reach a valve without re-anchoring the fall-arrest lanyard.
Technician climbed onto an elevated platform without a harness to inspect equipment.
